component.title: VirtualList
component.purpose: A large-collection surface that preserves the truth of the full collection while rendering only the useful window.

states.description: Measured activity rows remain readable while the status reports the full 120-item collection.
A compact command history keeps row rhythm and keyboard focus usable.
An empty collection has an honest status rather than an empty viewport.
A previously saved reading position is restored on mount.

claims.statement: Every rendered row exposes its position and the full collection size while the live status describes the visible window.
Rows are dynamically measured and overscanned instead of relying on a fixed-height rendering assumption.
Focus and restored scroll position remain part of the component contract when the rendered window changes.
